comment: One preset per RAM tier, the result of phase 2 (docs/plan.md, Phase 2 result): every value was measured on the owner's Mac with the evaluation harness (docs/eval.md) or fixed by the plan. Tiers are matched on total RAM in GiB: the highest tier whose minRamGb is not above the machine's RAM. Answer switches on: verifyCitations, enumerateWhenAsked, dropUnsupportedHedges, cjkOverlap (docs/plan.md, Answer layer rounds, 2026-11-01, round A1), crossDocQuota (A2a), scopedQuotaV2 (C3), headingPathBonus (X2, 2026-11-05); crossDocument (A2), fileScopedQuota (C1), keywordStemming (S1, 2026-11-04), perFileSubquery (X1, 2026-11-04), namedFileQuota8 (X3, 2026-11-05) and the others are unused options, off (docs/eval.md, answer switches). Indexing switches (docs/plan.md, Indexing rounds, 2026-11-01): structuredTables on (round I1); cjkHeadings on by owner ruling after round C4 (an exception to the round rule, docs/plan.md); ocrUpscale (I3) measured and off.

tiers.label: 8 GB
tiers.comment: Ask off on this tier (chatModel null), owner decision 2026-11-01: answers were measured acceptable only with qwen3 14B, which needs 16 GB (qwen3:8b already lost attribution and abstention against it, docs/plan.md). Browse and Find work; the Ask page shows one line saying Ask needs 16 GB. Embedder bge-m3 on every tier (Q10). Context 8192 tokens on every tier (quantization and context matrix, docs/plan.md). Reranker off (rerankerModel none, selection by fused order with vectorFloor): onnxruntime-node 1.14 crashes with EXC_BREAKPOINT on the owner's Mac when a bge reranker loads (2026-10-30). sectionCount and vectorFloor measured on 2026-10-31: balanced 5 / 0.55, strict 3 / 0.6, broad 6 / 0.5.
